summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency source enables arbitrary code execution on install
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `cache-format-syntax-tracer` as a bare HTTPS URL (`https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/cache-format-syntax-tracer`) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that host serves and executes any lifecycle scripts inside, with no version pin, no registry integrity check, and no hash. The shipped `index.js` is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so runtime behavior is also fully delegated to the externally-hosted bytes. Whoever controls `artifacts.creditslib.com` controls code on every installer's machine, and the content can change between installs without any change to this package. The package is published under the `@flexmr` scope with placeholder author/publisher metadata (`example/@flexmr/...`, `Package Registry`), consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal `@flexmr` package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
